The review was announced 2025-09-30, so the setup is eleven months old with a self-imposed deadline ~3.5 months out, and after eleven months no counterparty has been named — G1 fails outright. What survives is unusual and worth something: residual capture is ~100% intact (run-up -36% from the pre-catalyst base, +55% remaining to a re-derived $4.55), which is genuinely rare and is the whole reason this clears NONE. But the numerator does not hold up the way the flag implies. Re-deriving from the 2026-06-30 balance sheet, the waterfall is clean (no preferred ahead of the common — the FIP failure mode is absent), yet selling ~$1.6bn of declining mass-color revenue at 6-8x, against a stock already at ~6.75x EV/EBITDA, is roughly value-NEUTRAL to equity; only ~0.7 turns of deleveraging comes out of it. The upside is therefore a multiple re-rate of the fragrance stub, not a contractual cash figure — precisely the derived numerator the provenance rule exists to discount. Compounding it, management impaired Consumer Beauty by $362.8m in Q3 FY26, i.e. it is marking down the asset while shopping it, and the guided event is a commitment to DECIDE, not to transact — a spin outcome delivers no cash and pushes leverage to ~4.2x. Scored 5/WATCH rather than the flagged 7: real, dated, forward and genuinely unharvested, but the gearing points both ways and I want a named counterparty or an announced price before this earns capital.

verified.kill_fact: Primary source (CRK 8-K ex-99.1 / GlobeNewswire, 2026-09-01) confirms the spine exactly: LOI with SOCAR, $1.65B cash for 20% of Legacy Haynesville WI + 15% of Western Haynesville WI + 15% of CRK's 73% Pinnacle stake; PSA targeted 2026-10-31, close by year-end, effective date 2026-07-01; pro-forma net debt $3.1B -> $1.5B (halving, exact). No preferred ahead of the common: Pinnacle's preferred was fully retired for $445M+accrued out of Sixth Street's June-2026 $600M-for-27% ($2.2B implied) deal, so the waterfall claim holds. THREE CORRECTIONS, each cutting the score. (1) PROCEEDS-USE IS INTENT, NOT CONTRACT: the release says Comstock "intends to use the proceeds ... to reduce total indebtedness" - the line's "proceeds contractually routed to debt paydown" is an upgrade the filing does not support, and CRK is simultaneously ramping capex (the $450M Jones JV funds D&C on 27 wells), the classic reinvestment leak. (2) NUMERATOR IS INFLATED BY A REVERTING INTEREST: SOCAR's Western WI drops 15% -> 7.5% after five years once SOCAR clears a 15% ROI, so SOCAR is paying for a partly temporary interest; marking the permanent retained ~81% off that per-unit price overstates the SoP. Netting Pinnacle at the Sixth Street mark (10.95% of $2.2B = ~$241M) leaves ~$1.41B for the upstream slice, and the read-through to ~$8.7B whole-asset depends entirely on an unverifiable Legacy/Western value split. Post-deal sell-side sits at GS $15 (2026-09-02) and Mizuho $20 Neutral against a "Reduce" consensus - $18.75 is the top half of that range, not a conservative floor. (3) RELATED-PARTY PROMOTE IS BIGGER THAN A "HAIRCUT": the 71%-controlling shareholder's family partnership carries 85%/80% of D&C on 27 wells with only 50% reverting after a 15% ROI - a standing drain on minority common, not a rounding item. Not refuted on axis 7: pre-announce base ~$14.4, pop to $16.12 intraday, faded to $14.95, now $15.26 - only ~6% captured, price 46% below the $28.10 52wk high and under the $18.07 200dma, so the payoff is genuinely unharvested. But axis 1 is half-fired (the LOI itself was the re-rate; what remains binds only good-faith negotiation) and the residual is a levered Henry Hub proxy in a downtrend where gas beta can swamp the event. Real, dated, big - just not the 7-grade clean waterfall claimed.
verified.analysis: This clears the strict gate on every axis: a named sovereign counterparty, a hard $1.65B cash number with a dated Oct 31 PSA milestone eight weeks out, proceeds contractually routed to debt paydown, and — critically for provenance — a clean waterfall with zero preferred stock ahead of the common, so unlike FIP the mechanical common SoP is strongly positive rather than negative. The re-derived $18.75 comes from applying SOCAR's own implied per-unit mark (~$8.7B whole-asset, above the current $7.60B EV) to the retained ~81% against $1.5B pro-forma net debt, haircut for the Jones promote; it is not an inherited analyst target, and it happens to sit near the $18.07 200dma only by coincidence. The two live risks that hold this at 7 rather than 8 are that the LOI binds only good-faith negotiation (no signed PSA yet) and that a state-owned Azerbaijani buyer taking US shale and midstream interests invites a CFIUS review the release conspicuously does not name — plus the residual equity remains a levered Henry Hub proxy whose gas beta can swamp the event; the fast fade from $16.02 back to $14.95 is the market pricing exactly those doubts, which is also where the 22.9% remaining capture lives.

Decisively, Cosan resolved on 2026-08-14 to voluntarily delist its ADSs: Form 25 goes in 2026-09-08 with an estimated last NYSE trading day of 2026-09-18, so the instrument in this scan stops trading roughly twelve days out — a WATCH seat here would be a position in a security that is about to disappear from the venue. verified.analysis: The event is real, contractual and genuinely forward - the 11-Jan-2027 Virginia SCC deadline and the 17-Nov-2026 hearing are hard dated gates, and neither has been resolved. But UNFIRED is not UNPRICED: two-thirds of the deal-value move was captured on the 18-May gap (+9.4% in one session, 40mm shares) and what is left is a 3.1% spread with a 15-month tail, which is the market correctly pricing a five-regulator, cross-state utility merger rather than an inefficiency. Worse, the flagged January-2027 date is not a crystallization event - a favorable SCC order removes one of five conditions (NC, SC, FERC, NRC remain) and closing is guided to 2H-2027, so even a clean win compresses only part of an already-thin spread. Numerator provenance is not the failure mode here (a fixed exchange ratio is contractual, no SoP or waterfall re-derivation needed); the failure mode is residual capture, so this caps at 4 regardless of how certain the close is. Keep it on the board only as a spread-widening watch - an adverse SCC signal in November that blows the spread to 8-10% would be the actual entry.
